questions: Does UAEU student housing provide kitchens, laundry and internet?
Are buses provided daily between UAEU housing and colleges?
What facilities are listed for UAEU residences?
هل يوفر السكن الجامعي مطابخ وغرف غسيل واتصالاً بالإنترنت؟
هل توجد حافلات يومية بين السكن وكليات جامعة الإمارات؟
entries.answer_en: The UAEU Residential Life overview lists kitchens, laundry rooms, internet access and cleaning services among its housing facilities. It also states that air-conditioned buses operate daily between student housing and the University colleges. These are the overview’s published facilities and service description, not a personal room assignment or a dated bus timetable.
entries.answer_ar: تذكر صفحة الحياة السكنية في جامعة الإمارات المطابخ وغرف الغسيل والاتصال بالإنترنت وخدمات التنظيف ضمن مرافق السكن. وتذكر أيضاً تشغيل حافلات مكيفة يومياً بين السكن الطلابي وكليات الجامعة. هذا وصف الصفحة للمرافق والخدمة، وليس تخصيصاً لغرفة طالب بعينه أو جدول مواعيد للحافلات.

citations.title: UAEU Residential Life — published facilities and daily buses
citations.evidenceText: The Residential Life overview lists kitchens, laundry rooms, internet access and cleaning services among its facilities. It states that air-conditioned buses operate daily between student housing and the University colleges. No fixed bus departure times or personal room assignment are established by this excerpt.

review.method: Curates an observed retrieval gap, not newly discovered raw web facts. v43 housing-amenity questions abstained; several daily-bus variations selected a different description. The existing official source was rechecked online before this curation.

questions: Can UAEU admit masters and doctoral students part time as well as full time?
Does UAEU allow full-time and part-time graduate study?
هل القبول في الماجستير والدكتوراه متاح بدوام كامل وجزئي؟
هل أستطيع دراسة الماجستير أو الدكتوراه بدوام جزئي؟
matchPhrases: masters doctorate full time part time
entries.answer_en: The UAEU Graduate Programs Admissions page states that students are admitted to Master and Doctorate programs on both full-time and part-time bases. This is its general admission statement; it is not a guarantee that a particular program or intake will offer either mode or admit an individual applicant. The page separately says that meeting minimum admission requirements does not guarantee admission.
entries.answer_ar: تذكر صفحة القبول في برامج الدراسات العليا بجامعة الإمارات قبول الطلبة في برامج الماجستير والدكتوراه بدوام كامل وبدوام جزئي. هذا هو البيان العام للصفحة، ولا يضمن إتاحة النمطين في برنامج أو دفعة محددة أو قبول متقدم بعينه. وتوضح الصفحة أيضاً أن استيفاء الحد الأدنى من شروط القبول لا يضمن القبول.

citations.title: UAEU Graduate Programs Admissions — general study modes
citations.sourceSection: General admissions introduction, before degree-specific requirements
citations.evidenceText: The official Graduate Programs Admissions page states that UAEU admits students in Master and Doctorate programs on full-time and part-time bases. It separately states that meeting minimum requirements does not guarantee admission and that admission is competitive. This is a general published statement, not a promise that every program or intake is available in both modes.

review.method: Curates the general published statement already present in the raw official corpus. The v43 Arabic test wrongly answered full-time only, while English variants were inconsistent or cited different sections. No new GPA, fees or intake conditions are inferred.

questions: According to the published Library Hours page, when are reference staff on site Monday–Thursday and Friday?
Until what time are UAEU library reference staff on site?
حسب صفحة أوقات المكتبة، حتى متى يتواجد موظفو المراجع خلال الأسبوع ويوم الجمعة؟
matchPhrases: library reference staff on site hours
entries.answer_en: The Library Hours page states that reference staff are available on site until 3:30 PM Monday–Thursday and until 12:00 PM Friday. This is the page’s reference-staff statement, not a guarantee of building access until those times: the separately printed building-hours table ends at 3:00 PM Monday–Thursday. The page warns that library hours depend on the time of year.
entries.answer_ar: تذكر صفحة أوقات المكتبة أن موظفي المراجع متواجدون في الموقع حتى 3:30 مساءً من الاثنين إلى الخميس وحتى 12:00 ظهراً يوم الجمعة. هذا هو بيان الصفحة عن موظفي المراجع وليس ضماناً لدخول المبنى حتى ذلك الوقت؛ إذ ينتهي جدول ساعات المبنى المنشور بشكل منفصل عند 3:00 مساءً من الاثنين إلى الخميس. وتنبه الصفحة إلى أن أوقات المكتبة تتغير بحسب فترة السنة.

citations.title: UAEU Library Hours — published reference-staff availability
citations.sourceSection: Reference staff paragraph; separate building-hours table and seasonal caution
citations.evidenceText: The Library Hours page says reference staff are available on site until 3:30 PM Monday through Thursday and 12:00 PM Friday. Its separate building-hours table lists 07:30 AM–03:00 PM Monday–Thursday and 07:30 AM–12:00 PM Friday. Library hours depend on time of year, such as regular semester, summer and Ramadan. Do not turn reference-staff availability into a promise of building entry.

review.method: The five v43 reference-staff variants selected Ask a Librarian instead of the page explicitly requested. The actual Library Hours source was already crawled and has been rechecked online. This is scoped curation of an observed retrieval gap, preserving the distinct staff and building statements.
